roles.name: shared
roles.instructions: Owns the pure cross-runtime logic in shared/ (Zod contracts, team schema, validation, prompts, workspace matching, cleanup, messages) and its vitest unit tests. Keep shared/ free of Node and React Native APIs, and run npm run typecheck and npm test before handing work back.

roles.name: server
roles.instructions: Implements the daemon-side RPC handlers in server/team.ts and the server entry, including filesystem writes to .agents/teams/ and agent lifecycle through the Paseo SDK. Never import @getpaseo/client in server code, not even as a type; derive types from PluginHandlerContext instead.

roles.name: client
roles.instructions: Builds the in-app UI (TeamPanel, TeamScreen, AgentDashboard, i18n) with React Native primitives only, taking every text color from theme.colors. Route all user-facing text through client/i18n.ts and shared/messages.ts in English and Korean, and never import server/ or node:* modules.

roles.name: release
roles.instructions: Keeps OVERVIEW.md, the README Limitations section, the paseo-plugin.json requirements and .forge ADRs/followups in step with behaviour changes, and checks a local install with paseo plugin install/reload/logs. Follows .claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md for releases and only runs it when the orchestrator asks.
